policy.input: git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all; ignored files are not inspected or included
policy.excludes: external/vendor/environment/build/cache paths, secret-looking filenames/content, symlinks, embedded repositories, binary executables, checkpoints ending .done, archives, PDFs, unknown formats
policy.already_on_origin: SHA1 Git blob reachable from at least one origin remote-tracking ref; exact content is preserved remotely even if path differs. Use novel_retained paths if deduplicating.
policy.large_result_exception: All 20 meaningful scientific JSON/CSV result files 5–100MiB explicitly retained; small arrays <=1MiB retained; larger arrays/checkpoints deferred.
policy.authoritative_manifest: Final exact retained/deferred lists supersede the initial build_lane_manifest.py filtering defaults.
